## Required course materials

### WileyPLUS

WileyPLUS access for Howard Anton, *Elementary Linear Algebra: Applications
Version*, 12th edition, is required. All homework will be assigned, completed
individually, and automatically graded through WileyPLUS. Launch each homework
assignment from [Canvas]({{< meta canvas.course >}}); do not search for or join
the course separately on the WileyPLUS website.

Purchase single-term access when prompted after launching a WileyPLUS
assignment in Canvas. WileyPLUS includes the online textbook for the duration
of the course.

### Textbook

Howard Anton, *Elementary Linear Algebra: Applications Version*, 12th
edition. The online textbook is included with required WileyPLUS access, so a
separate printed copy is optional.

## Computing resources

The course will use Python for numerical and symbolic matrix computation,
visualization, and experimentation. Use the repository-access instructions for
initial setup and the Notebooks page for validated demonstrations.

<details>
<summary><strong>Initial Python environment</strong></summary>

- NumPy for array and numerical matrix computation
- SciPy for scientific computing
- Matplotlib for visualization
- SymPy for exact symbolic computation
- JupyterLab for demonstrations and exercises

</details>
